title: 광업ㆍ제조업조사 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02055:20251001:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the National Data Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 2055, October 1, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Rules on the Mining and Manufacturing Survey shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 3, Article 4 (1) 6, paragraph (2) of the same Article, Article 5 (2) and (3), the proviso to Article 6 (3), paragraph (4) of the same Article, Article 7 (1), Article 8, Article 9 (1), Article 10 (3), Article 11 (1) and (2), Article 12, Article 13 (1) and (2), the former and latter parts of Article 14, the portion other than each subparagraph of Article 15, and Article 16, "Commissioner of Statistics Korea" shall each be replaced with "Administrator of the National Data Agency."
(3) through (7) Omitted.
